body.x: At CES 2023, CookingPal featured Pronto, an intelligent, 8-in-1 pressure cooker that provides digital assistance and automation to make healthy, delicious meals. The company said that Pronto is a unique multifunctional device that substitutes multiple home appliances and is the first pressure cooker with a fixed-hinged lid, an auto pressure release system, and an Air Fryer extension. This cooker is CookingPal’s latest gadget to connect to its Smart Kitchen Hub platform after Multo, the Intelligent Cooking System the company debuted last year. At the booth, CookingPal displayed Pronto with Multo.

CookingPal said Pronto provides a seamless, convenient hands-off, and safe cooking experience for people who want to outsmart conventional cooking, saving time and effort. Its functions include pressure cooking, sautee, slow cook, steaming, fermentation, sanitizing, keeping warm, weighing via an integrated scale, and air frying with the air fryer attachment sold separately.

body.cap: Pronto's Air Fryer attachment that is sold separately | Photo by AVING News

body.x: CookingPal said Pronto reduces manual labor from the cooking by handling multiple cooking tasks, including scaling, chopping, mixing, steaming, kneading, sautéing, and more. Users also can control and monitor Pronto via its 4.3-inch color screen with a jog dial and two-button interface or through the CookingPal companion app.

The company emphasized that Pronto is simple, convenient, and safe. It said that Pronto has a spring-loaded and fixed hinge lid different from detaching covers of other pressure cookers - reducing the risk and stress of equipment displacement. Its 6-quart removable main bowl comes with cool-to-the-touch handles, ideal for serving four family members. Safety sensors and auto pressure release function ensure safe pressure management, while its steam diverter protects from direct pressure stream.

body.cap: CookingPal's previous Smart kitchen appliance, Multo | Photo by AVING News

body.x: It then highlighted its design philosophy of simplicity and a ‘less-but-better’ design inside Pronto. Its mechanical functions balance with superior ergonomics, while the distinctive white coloring with black and charcoal accents evokes a tech-enhanced futuristic lifestyle.

The Pronto set includes an ergonomic spatula with a built-in rest, a measuring cup, and a steaming basket with non-scratch silicone feet and handles for safe and easy removal. The user can purchase a separate Smart Air Fryer attachment with four main functions: air fry, roast, bake, and grill. This frying add-on, a first for pressure cookers, transforms Pronto into an air fryer. CookingPal said it developed this to accommodate the rising demand for Air Fryer that cooks food healthier, faster, and crispier with less oil - without buying an entirely new appliance.

body.cap: CookingPal Smart Kitchen Hub | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The company continued that Pronto can connect to the CookingPal Smart Kitchen Hub for added strength. This automated digital assistant promises to regulate a portfolio of connected CookingPal cooking appliances and help users make meals with expert guidance, culinary resources, and minimal effort. Multo can also connect to the Smart Kitchen Hub and cooperate with Pronto.

The hub provides access to 100s of nutritional recipes with step-by-step guided prep and cooking instructions. Users can also book real-time cooking tutorials with live CookingPal chefs, and watch visual tutorials and life lessons intended to inspire ideas. Its ever-growing recipe library supplies nutritional knowledge to help people follow health goals, in-depth ingredients information, and places to buy.
Pronto will be available in Q3 2023 and will retail at $279. The CookingPal Air Fryer attachment will be available in Q4 at $119. Multo by CookingPal is currently on the market, priced at $999.
